ops.statement: When an issue inherits a prior run's diagnosis or the fix locus is uncertain, make gate-1 an EVIDENCE-ONLY diagnosis with a decide-fix human checkpoint BEFORE any code, and re-plan the frozen gates at the checkpoint from the evidence. A confidently-stated inherited premise can be wrong: don't author the fix gates assuming it.
